# Aouda

> Aouda is a columnar database engine for .NET with a TypeScript client SDK (`@aouda/client`).
> Dual deployment: embedded (in-process, no server needed) or server (standalone HTTP server).
> Schema-on-write by default. Zero index management. AI-native bootstrap with `aouda dev`.
> Two-layer auth model: server auth (who can connect) + application auth (your app's end users).

## Quick orientation

- Install CLI: `dotnet tool install -g Aouda.Cli`
- Start dev server: `aouda dev` (port 5433, database "default", schema-on-write)
- Install .NET client: `dotnet add package Aouda.Client`
- Install TypeScript client: `npm install @aouda/client`
- Docker: `docker run -p 5000:5000 -v aouda-data:/data aouda/server`

- [Testing](https://aoudadb.github.io/getting-started/testing/): In-process integration tests with Aouda.Testing package
- [Backup and Restore](https://aoudadb.github.io/getting-started/backup/): Incremental backups, PITR, S3-compatible storage

- [Setup and Flows](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/setup/): Signup, signin, token lifecycle, practical setup sequences

- [Auth Reference](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/reference/): API endpoints, error codes, operational notes

- [Partitioning and Multi-tenancy](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/partitioning/): Partition keys, tenant isolation
- [Time-series and Clustering](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/time-series/): Cluster declaration, partition functions, delta handling
